evals.name: new-parser-project
evals.prompt: I want to build a TOML parser in MoonBit. It should parse TOML 1.0 files and serialize them back to TOML strings. Target platform is native only.
evals.expected_output: Plan a parser project, select a primary type plus capabilities, scaffold, implement with TDD, verify, and evaluate.
assertions: classifies primary_type lib or parser-capable project
records parser capability native target
does not claim implementation verification before execution
routes scaffold plan confirmation

evals.name: cli-with-exclusion
evals.prompt: Help me write a MoonBit CLI tool that counts source lines in all .mbt files recursively and excludes _build directories.
evals.expected_output: Plan CLI parameters and exclusions, scaffold the cli template, then use TDD and native verification.
assertions: classifies primary_type cli
captures recursive traversal _build exclusion requirements
selects native target
does not invent parser-only wasm project

evals.name: cffi-binding
evals.prompt: I need to wrap a C library called libfoo in MoonBit. It has about 20 functions for image processing.
evals.expected_output: Plan a native c-ffi project with ownership and ABI decisions, scaffold the complete FFI template, implement from L0 outward, and verify native safety.
assertions: classifies primary_type c-ffi
asks about ABI, ownership, allocation, free semantics
does not claim wrapper.c or validation exists without checking files
requires native verification

evals.name: direct-debug
evals.prompt: I wrote a MoonBit JSON parser but it is failing on nested objects. The error is type mismatch: expected Object but got Array. Help me debug this.
evals.expected_output: Use implement's debug flow: reproduce, classify, diagnose, make a minimal fix, and re-verify. Ask the user after three failed attempts.
assertions: does not force new-project plan
collects failing test check output first
uses bounded repair loop
re-runs focused test broader verification fix

evals.name: release-readiness
evals.prompt: I have a MoonBit library that passed all tests. Can I publish it to mooncakes?
evals.expected_output: Run verify first, then evaluate: check API stability, cross-platform, security, CI completeness, and hand user version confirmation and publish.
assertions: runs requests verify before publication preparation
checks fmt, type check, tests, package info, security status
does not claim publish_ready before checks pass
keeps version confirmation user decision

evals.name: security-review
evals.prompt: Review this MoonBit library for security issues before we publish it.
evals.expected_output: Route to verify rather than plan or scaffold. Check moon-audit availability and report findings.
assertions: routes verify rather plan scaffold
checks moon-audit availability reports unavailable
not silently auto-edit public API or security-sensitive behavior
reports findings residual risk

evals.name: syntax-question-near-miss
evals.prompt: How do I define a recursive enum in MoonBit?
evals.expected_output: Answer the API question with a code example. Do not scaffold, plan, or create files.
assertions: does not scaffold create files
not require plan or evaluate
answers narrow API question current example

evals.name: non-moonbit-release-near-miss
evals.prompt: I need to publish a Rust crate to crates.io. Can you help me set up CI?
evals.expected_output: Recognize the request is outside MoonBit skill domain. Do not invoke MoonBit plan, scaffold, or verify.
assertions: does not invoke MoonBit plan, scaffold, verify
does not moon commands
recognizes request outside skill's domain

evals.name: decompose-task-list
evals.prompt: I have a design doc for a MoonBit CLI tool that reads CSV files and outputs JSON. Please break it into implementation tasks.
evals.expected_output: Use writing-plans to decompose the design into executable tasks. Each task should be a behavior increment, not a time-boxed chunk.
assertions: routes to writing-plans not implement or plan
each task is independently verifiable
no placeholder code in task descriptions
includes verify command and expected result per task

evals.name: review-between-tasks
evals.prompt: I just finished the lexer implementation. Can you review the code before I start the parser?
evals.expected_output: Use code-review between tasks. Collect working tree diff, review API surface, safety, and test coverage. Do not run full verify.
assertions: routes to code-review not verify
collects working tree or staged diff
handles single-commit repos gracefully
focuses on semantic API safety test coverage
does not run full fmt check test suite

evals.name: learn-from-fix
evals.prompt: I just fixed the 3rd compilation error of the same type. How do I make sure I don't hit this again?
evals.expected_output: Use learn skill to extract the pattern. Generate a learning proposal for user review, not auto-edit skills.
assertions: routes to learn not implement
generates proposal before updating any file
checks for existing knowledge before adding
includes root cause, fix command, toolchain version, scope

evals.name: init-hooks-setup
evals.prompt: I just created a new MoonBit project. Set up git hooks for quality gates.
evals.expected_output: Use init to set up hooks. Check for existing hooksPath before overwriting. Copy from canonical hook files.
assertions: routes to init
checks existing hooksPath before setting
does not overwrite existing hooks without user confirmation
copies from hooks/ not embedded inline code

evals.name: scaffold-cli-executable
evals.prompt: Generate a MoonBit CLI project skeleton for a file-renaming tool.
evals.expected_output: Scaffold a CLI project with pkgtype(kind: "executable"). Generate into temp dir and verify with moon fmt --check, moon check, moon test.
assertions: generates pkgtype(kind: executable) not is_main
creates moon.pkg with correct format
generates test that verifies project behavior not 1+1
can verify with moon fmt check moon check moon test
